name: 11771 · Oyster Bay, NY
findings: ZIP 11771 (Oyster Bay) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11771 (Oyster Bay) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11771 (Oyster Bay) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
